remarks: Experience the very best of Westport from this beautifully appointed Colonial, perfectly nestled on a quiet street in one of the town's most desirable locations. Bordering Birchwood Country Club and just moments from Saugatuck, downtown Westport, Metro-North, award-winning restaurants, boutique shopping, and some of Connecticut's most beautiful beaches, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy an effortless lifestyle in the heart of it all.  Privately set on a picturesque, professionally landscaped .21-acre property, the home offers approximately 3,200 square feet of thoughtfully finished living space designed for both comfortable everyday living and elegant entertaining. A charming front porch welcomes you inside, where sun-filled interiors, timeless architecture, and refined finishes create a warm yet sophisticated atmosphere throughout.  At the center of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen that flows seamlessly into the inviting family room while overlooking the beautiful patio and fully fenced backyard-an idyllic setting for morning coffee, summer evenings, and effortless indoor-outdoor living.  The home features five spacious bedrooms, four full bathrooms, and one half bath, including a luxurious primary suite with generous walk-in closets and a spa-inspired bath. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths complete the second level, while a spacious mudroom adds everyday convenience.
